SOC0.label: ASSUMPTION
SOC0.cite: P1 state of charge at 16:00 (build prompt 5.4.1)

BATTERY_PF.label: ASSUMPTION
BATTERY_PF.cite: inverter at unity power factor; fixes the prototype's default 0.88 pf (build prompt 4.4)

COMMS_STALE_S.label: ASSUMPTION
COMMS_STALE_S.cite: silent unit marked stale; §12 Q4 (prototype COMMS_STALE_SECONDS)

LEASE_TTL_S.label: ASSUMPTION
LEASE_TTL_S.cite: one 5-minute interval: docs/design.md §10 'Command expiry and lease TTL'

RUNTIME_PARTITIONS.label: ASSUMPTION
RUNTIME_PARTITIONS.cite: one transformer group per worker at the start

PARTITION_RULE.value: fleet transformers in index order, cut into RUNTIME_PARTITIONS contiguous groups of about equal battery count; a transformer is never split
PARTITION_RULE.label: ASSUMPTION

SHARE_RULE.value: each group gets its own batteries' share of the fleet target (the P1 formula per battery), capped at the group's headroom (sim.caps H per transformer); the rest goes to groups with room left, in proportion to that room. A group whose worker missed its last heartbeat is booked at its batteries' telemetry kW
SHARE_RULE.label: ASSUMPTION

KILL_AFTER_MIN.label: ASSUMPTION
KILL_AFTER_MIN.cite: the worker holding focus A's group is killed at Tc + 20 min, mid-ramp (P1 aware charges about 590 kW then)

LATE_BATCH_RULE.value: the killed worker's last batch (computed at the kill step, never delivered) reaches the devices late, right after the takeover's commands: 'a dead or paused worker' moving power late
LATE_BATCH_RULE.label: ASSUMPTION

SEQ_SCOPE.value: seq restarts at 1 with every lease grant; devices order commands by (epoch, seq)
SEQ_SCOPE.label: ASSUMPTION

RUNTIME_TRACKING_PCT.label: ASSUMPTION
RUNTIME_TRACKING_PCT.cite: the percentage term of docs/design.md §4.2's max(2 MW, 15%); the 2 MW term exceeds this 96-Core fleet (1.92 MW), so only the percentage gates

load.label: SIM
load.text: fixture: sim.fixtures.FixtureLoads, synthetic, not a result

referee.label: SIM
referee.text: OpenDSSDirect.py 0.9.4 AC power flow, every step

runtime.label: SIM
runtime.text: resilience.runtime: RUNTIME_WORKERS workers hold leases on transformer groups and run sim.orchestrator.Controller unchanged inside each; devices order commands by (epoch, seq)

focus.label: SIM
focus.by: home load (SMART-DS, interpolated) and battery kW per transformer

reverse.label: SIM
reverse.unit: [step, tf] where the transformer's net P < 0 (back-feed)

partitionTargetKW.label: SIM
partitionTargetKW.by: the coordinator's share per group (booked telemetry while unserved)

partitionDeliveredKW.label: SIM
partitionDeliveredKW.by: sum of the group's battery kW

holder.label: SIM
holder.unit: one char per group: the worker whose commands it got that step, '-' none

baseline.label: SIM
baseline.by: the same evening under the runtime, no failure

killCostKWh.cite: energy delivered without the kill minus with it, kill to end of window

divergenceMaxKW.label: SIM

targetPct.label: DERIVED
targetPct.cite: as a share of that minute's target

lateCommands.cite: the killed worker's last batch, delivered right after the takeover (LATE_BATCH_RULE)

lateUnexpiredOnArrival.label: SIM
lateUnexpiredOnArrival.cite: late commands whose expiry had not passed when they landed: only the epoch can stop them

rejectedStaleEpoch.label: SIM
rejectedStaleEpoch.cite: deliveries refused: epoch older than the device's newest

rejectedNonIncreasingSeq.label: SIM
rejectedNonIncreasingSeq.cite: deliveries refused: seq not above the last in the same epoch

rejectedExpired.label: SIM
rejectedExpired.cite: deliveries refused: expiry passed on arrival

seqOnlyLateAccepted.label: SIM
seqOnlyLateAccepted.cite: counterfactual: late commands a seq-only device (sim.devices.Device) would have accepted

seqOnlyTakeoverRejected.label: SIM
seqOnlyTakeoverRejected.cite: counterfactual: of the new holder's 2046 commands, how many a seq-only device would have refused (seq restarts at 1 with every grant)
